$comment: Canonical jargon ban-list data. Single source of truth for every voice surface. The check-jargon hook reads autoMatched[].pattern (case-insensitive ERE) and greps prose against it. Human-readable companion: jargon-banlist.md.

autoMatched.prefer: name the actual layer or store
"X is in Y" / "X is defined in Y"
"durable advantage" / say what actually keeps competitors out

judgementCalls.note: Vague architectural metaphors. Name the real thing (the parser, the boundary between modules, the validation step). Fine when it's a literal identifier in the code.
Don't silently turn initialVerification into IV. Spell it out; coining an abbreviation pollutes the domain's own vocabulary.
If a fresh reader couldn't define the concept from the surrounding text, define it or cut it.
The real tell isn't any one word, it's density: metaphors piled on invented nouns, shorthand written to yourself rather than to the reader.
"where the ticket data sinks" / "sink unproven" — say "where the data lands" / "destination". Fine as the literal term for a Flink/stream/event sink.
